SELECT tu.user_name AS userName, tu.avatar AS avatar, tu.create_time AS createTimeStr, CASE WHEN m.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mutual_follow FROM sc_follow AS f LEFT JOIN sc_follow AS m ON f.user_id = m.by_id AND f.classify = 3 AND m.classify = 3 LEFT JOIN tb_user tu ON f.by_id = tu.user_id WHERE f.by_id = #{userId} AND f.classify = 3
